Comment: Standalone R7 test only. Explicit registered target; check/isolate/restore modes. No detection trigger. No automatic rollback or ambiguous mutation retries.

InvalidInput.Cause: Use mode check/isolate/restore and the registered instance_id. check/isolate also require evidence_id.

BaselineNotRestored.Cause: The target is not in the registered restored baseline. Inspect the result and complete a separate restore execution first.

PreflightFailed.Cause: An identity, baseline, or permission preflight failed. No isolation action has started.

EvidenceIdAlreadyUsed.Cause: Choose a new evidence_id for this isolation test. No isolation action has started.

SSMSubmissionUnconfirmed.Cause: Command submission or SG verification was not confirmed. Do not blindly resend. Inspect send.data; isolation may already be applied.

SSMCommandFailed.Cause: SSM returned a failed or unrecognized completion result. Inspect connection.data. If isolating, SG may remain applied.

SSMPollLimitExceeded.Cause: SSM did not finish within 20 polls. Inspect the command status. SG may remain applied.

UnexpectedSSMResult.Cause: The completed SSM command mode does not match this execution mode.

ConnectionTestFailed.Cause: The controlled TCP self-test did not return test_passed true.

IsolationCleanupFailed.Cause: Registered TCP scope cleanup and current isolation SG were not both verified. SG may remain applied.

ConnectionTerminationNotObserved.Cause: No existing connection was observed terminated although this test required it. SG remains applied. Restore and arrange a live registered-scope connection before a new test.

NACLIsolationFailed.Cause: NACL configuration was not verified. SG and owned partial NACL rules may remain applied.

IAMIsolationFailed.Cause: The target-specific IAM Deny configuration was not verified. SG and NACL may remain applied.

SnapshotCreationFailed.Cause: A new evidence snapshot was not confirmed. Isolation remains applied; inspect snapshot_create.data.

SnapshotFailed.Cause: Snapshot completion failed or the returned snapshot ID differs. Isolation remains applied.

SnapshotPollLimitExceeded.Cause: Snapshot did not complete within 60 polls. Isolation remains applied; inspect its AWS state.

TaskFailed.Cause: A Lambda invocation failed. Inspect task_error and the failed state input. Isolation actions are not automatically repeated or rolled back.

RestoreTaskFailed.Cause: A restore Lambda invocation failed. Inspect task_error; recovery may be partially complete. Keep executions serialized.

RestoreVerificationFailed.Cause: A recovery stage was not verified. Subsequent recovery stages were not started. Inspect the stage output and finish recovery separately.
